candidate.name: intraday_amount_clock_dispersion_240m
candidate.mechanism: normalized amount-weighted second central moment of the complete continuous-session minute clock
candidate.formula: with x_i=i/239 and w_i=amount_i/sum(amount), return 4*sum_i w_i*(x_i-sum_j w_j*x_j)^2 over exactly 240 standard bars

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Multiply every one of the 240 amount values by the same finite positive constant.
Reverse the complete 240-position amount vector in time.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: amount center of mass, peak recency, late-window share, terminal-bar share, and signed temporal allocation

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Move two equal amount masses symmetrically farther apart while retaining their probabilities and entropy.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: amount participation entropy and maximum amount share, which ignore clock distance

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Translate all nonzero amount masses by the same feasible number of clock bins without changing their relative distances.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: amount center of mass and fixed opening, late, or terminal window shares

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Permute the same amount multiset so that pairwise clock distances change while amount probabilities remain identical.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: permutation-invariant amount entropy, peak magnitude, and concentration statistics

semantic_invariance_checks.intervention: Hold the complete amount path fixed while changing every minute and daily OHLC, return, range, transaction price, financial statement value, issuer event, and market-peer path.
semantic_invariance_checks.distinguishes_from: all price-path, volatility, return-state, event, quarterly, market-coupling, and Candidate49 mechanisms

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_center_of_mass_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both treat amount as probability weights on minute clock time
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: center of mass is the first moment and changes under time translation or reversal; Campaign077 is the second central moment and depends only on dispersion around its own weighted mean

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_participation_entropy_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both summarize the full normalized amount distribution
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: entropy is invariant to every time permutation; Campaign077 uses normalized squared clock distance and changes when the same probabilities are rearranged

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_peak_amount_bar_recency_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: both read the same exact 240 amount bars
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: Campaign076 retains only the latest exact maximum position; Campaign077 uses every amount as a weight and is invariant to time reversal

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: late_amount_share_30m, intraday_terminal_bar_amount_share_240m, and intraday_opening_auction_amount_share_241m
nearest_semantic_challenges.relationship: all respond to temporal allocation of amount
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: fixed-window shares depend on chosen bucket membership and absolute clock location; Campaign077 uses no selected subwindow and is centered on its own weighted mean

nearest_semantic_challenges.name: intraday_amount_profile_serial_persistence_240m, intraday_morning_afternoon_amount_profile_similarity_120b, intraday_day_over_day_amount_profile_similarity_240b, and intraday_market_amount_profile_synchronization_240m
nearest_semantic_challenges.distinction: the prior factors compare the profile to adjacent bins, another half, another day, or the market; Campaign077 is a single-session scalar geometric moment with no reference profile
